text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Option B 19.0 to 19.8 s. From overhead the white roof-pod car stands still in the fully flooded street between the houses. At 19.6 s a faint amber glow appears at its corners. The car is small, about a quarter of the frame width.
